unit: No public study found gives cost or energy per tonne recovered as an explicit function of the recovery rate achieved for a single material stream. The assembled evidence is either a two-point ladder (initial versus deep sorting), a break-even rate, or an aggregate capital outlay for a stated rise in a national rate.
source: B4 literature search, 2026-09-17
